build_xpersona_data: build the XPersona multilingual persona-based dialogue dataset for ParlAI across 7 languages
run_build_function: run the build function to download and prepare XPersona data for a given datapath option
create_parlai_format: create ParlAI text format files from downloaded XPersona JSON persona and dialogue data
download_xpersona_resources: download XPersona dataset files for English, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese
convert_json_to_parlai_txt: convert XPersona JSON files containing personas and dialogues into ParlAI tab-separated text format
